name: vibest-herdr-app
description: Vibest's herdr-app interface: a layout, light and dark themes, and one mod per layout block that herdr-app's shipped mods do not cover: a T3 Code style sidebar and top bar, and a panel of vibest sessions.

scripts.build: bun build src/*/*/vibest-*.ts --entry-naming "[name]/main.[ext]" --outdir home/mods --format esm --target browser --external gpui-kit --external gpui-base --external herdr
scripts.check: for mod in home/mods/*/; do herdr-app check "$mod" || exit 1; done
